items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Did you ever work with Buddy or Yanks or any of those guys?

ctx.x: I used to play Frankie Deucon there once in a while. He played slide and trombone with Frankie Deucon. Tall, slender, dog, fall, black, cut of hair. He lived across the river. Frankie Deucon. Buddy Johnson lived across the river too. Because you know of him, trombone player. Buddy Johnson. He lived across the river. A little short for him.
Did you ever work with Buddy or Yanks or any of those guys?
No. I used to work with another, with Bunk Johnson. You heard talk of Bunk?
